name: DemoBot Tool Guard
description: Governed before_tool_call: DemoBot tool policy + NemoClaw policy layer + Cisco AI Defense inspect every agent tool call before execution; after_tool_call reports sandbox policy denials

guardUrl.description: Base URL of the DemoBot app as seen from the gateway/sandbox, e.g. http://host.containers.internal:8001 (podman) or http://<host ip>:8001 (NemoClaw)

accessKey.description: DemoBot ACCESS_KEY (sent as HTTP Basic password)

failOpen.description: true = allow tool calls when the guard is unreachable; false (default) = fail closed and block

timeoutMs.description: HTTP timeout for the guard call in milliseconds (keep under the hook timeoutMs of 10000)

agentSurface.description: Attribution label for governance events: openclaw (default) or nemoclaw when running inside the NemoClaw/OpenShell sandbox
